en: A colorized vintage view over a small town at the foot of a forested hill. In the foreground are several low, pale buildings with red roofs and simple classical detailing, lining a light-colored street or square. Behind them, more houses and a few larger structures sit among dense trees, all overlooked by a steep, wooded hillside. Printed text in the upper left corner reads in Romanian, identifying the scene and indicating it is a general view toward a park.
